name: Grade 4 Mathematics: Fractions
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to identify and represent fractions using shapes
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to compare fractions with the same denominator
learningActivities: Revision: learners identify halves and quarters from shaded shapes
Demonstration: teacher folds paper into equal parts to show fractions
Group work: learners shade given fractions of shapes
Comparison: learners use fraction strips to compare fractions
keyPoints: A fraction shows equal parts of a whole
The top number is the numerator and the bottom number is the denominator
The denominator shows the number of equal parts the whole is divided into
commonMisconceptions: Thinking the denominator is the shaded part
Counting parts that are not equal when identifying fractions
lessonEvaluation: Learners shade given fractions and compare fractions with the same denominator. Teacher assesses through observation.
teacherReflection: Learners enjoyed folding paper. More practice needed on writing fractions correctly.
